scenario.irule:
when CLIENT_ACCEPTED { set ::access_sid [ACCESS::session create -flow -timeout 600 -lifetime 3600]; ACCESS::session modify -sid $::access_sid -timeout 900 -remaining 450; ACCESS::flowid flow-updated; ACCESS::enable }
when HTTP_REQUEST { ACCESS::acl eval /Common/web; set acl_values [list [ACCESS::acl lookup] [ACCESS::acl matched] [ACCESS::acl result]]; ACCESS::perflow set perflow.custom changed-custom; ACCESS::perflow set perflow.scratchpad scratch-value; set data_before [ACCESS::session data get -sid $::access_sid session.user.name]; ACCESS::session data set -sid $::access_sid session.testcl updated; set data_after [ACCESS::session data get -sid $::access_sid session.testcl]; set exists [ACCESS::session exists -sid $::access_sid -state_allow]; set key [ACCESS::user getkey alice-hash]; set sid_from_key [ACCESS::user getsid $key]; set uuid_sid [ACCESS::uuid getsid $::access_sid]; ACCESS::policy evaluate -sid $::access_sid -profile /Common/access session.role admin; set policy [ACCESS::policy result -sid $::access_sid]; ACCESS::log notice "access-policy"; log local0. "acl=$acl_values data=$data_before/$data_after exists=$exists key=$key sid=$sid_from_key uuid=$uuid_sid policy=$policy flow=[ACCESS::flowid] perflow=[ACCESS::perflow get perflow.custom]"; ACCESS::disable; ACCESS::respond 202 content accepted }

when CLIENT_ACCEPTED { set ::access_sid [ACCESS::session create -flow] }
when HTTP_REQUEST { set password [ACCESS::ephemeral-auth create -user bob -auth_cfg default_radius -sid $::access_sid]; set verified [ACCESS::ephemeral-auth verify -user bob -password $password -protocol http]; set token [ACCESS::oauth sign -payload claims -key jwk]; set key [ACCESS::user getkey bob-hash]; set sid [ACCESS::user getsid $key]; ACCESS::session remove -sid $::access_sid; set exists [ACCESS::session exists -sid $::access_sid]; log local0. "verified=$verified token=$token key=$key sid=$sid exists=$exists"; HTTP::respond 200 content "verified=$verified token=$token key=$key sid=$sid exists=$exists" }
